scripts.build: npm run build -w libs/shared && npm run build -w apps/first-app && npm run build -w apps/second-app
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/first-app" "npm run dev -w apps/second-app"
scripts.preview: concurrently "npm run preview -w apps/first-app" "npm run preview -w apps/second-app"
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/first-app && npm run test -w apps/second-app
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e -w apps/first-app-e2e && npm run e2e -w apps/second-app-e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w libs/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/first-app && npm run typecheck -w apps/second-app && npm run typecheck -w apps/first-app-e2e && npm run typecheck -w apps/second-app-e2e
